en.bdb: The pirs and paigambars (messengers of Lord) worship Him.
The shaikhs and many other worshippers remain in His shelter.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਉਸ ਕੁਤਬ ਕਈ ਲੋਇ ਦਰ ਬਖਸੰਦਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: gaus kutab kiee loi dhar bakhasa(n)dhagee|

en.bdb: The gaues and qutabs (spiritualists of Islam) of many places beg for His grace at His door.
Dervishs in their trance stand at His gate to receive (alms from Him)

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਲੀ ਉਲਹ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੋਇ ਕਰਨਿ ਪਸੰਦਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: valee uleh sun soi karan pasa(n)dhagee|

en.bdb: Listening to the praises of that Lord many walls also love Him.
A rare person of high fortune reaches His court.
